dataList.content:
You...
你……
dataList.place:
T Corp.’s Streets
T公司街道 某处

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
EEEEK!!!
噫！！！

Quiet… Or you’ll attract even more of ‘em to us.
给我安静……乱叫的话引来更多人怎么办。

Shut your gob right now or we’ll feed you to the meat grinder back at our rickety, cannibal bus. Is that clear?
如果你不赶紧闭嘴，我就把你拖到吃人的巴士那儿，然后把你喂给那堆废铁，嗯？

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
T-then...
这……这么说……

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
You’re not here to kidnap me?
你们不是来……绑架我的人？

No. For the… I don’t even know how many times we’ve told you.
不是啊，我们已经重复了多少遍了……

Of course not, indeed! For we are the Limbu— Fix— Justi—
那绝无可能！！吾等是偶然路过的……正义的……边……收尾……

… She is trying so, so hard not to say it.
……好好忍耐住了呢，堂吉诃德。

… the passers-by. Of justice. Sir Heathcliff here can be rather brutish in his manner of speech, that is all...
不，吾等只是旅行者。那里的希斯克利夫先生也只是语气有些许偏执而已……

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
R-right… Passers-by of justice...
这……这样啊。旅行者……

So why are they asking us for time, not money?
但为什么那群人不是要钱，而是来抢时间呢？

… Maybe time’s just another commodity to be sold and bought here.
时间……也可以用来买卖吗？

Guys… is it just me again…? The T Corp. pamphlet guide... did no one really...?
T公司指南……又没读……又没……？

…Ishmael’s eyes start to glaze over. Once again, she may have been the only Sinner who bothered to read up on our destination…
以实玛利的目光飘忽不定。这次也不出所料地，似乎又只有以实玛利一人研究了目的地的情报……

In T Corp… also known as TimeTrack Corporation...
T公司……即时轨公司……

… its citizenry utilizes timepieces as personal identification. They oft trade with ‘time’ instead of physical currency; their means of transaction done via the timepieces they carry. Most laborers in these lands are rewarded for their efforts with time.
……它的居民将钟表作为身份证件。他们通过所携带的钟表，使用时间而非实体通货作为交易货币。在这里许多工人以时间作为工资。

Haah… thanks for the explanation, Yi Sang. I’ll let it slide this time.
哈……谢谢解释，李箱先生。这次就算了。

<So… is this going to be a problem? Outis is the only one of us who carries a watch.>
<我们之中带着钟表的人……好像只有奥提斯吧，这没问题吗？>

Ohh~ you mean her broken wristwatch? I always thought that wearing a stopped watch was a neat fashion statement—
啊~你是说她坏掉的手表？我还以为那是什么时尚……

… It’s not a fashion item. It never was. How insolent of you to assume.
……这不是什么时尚单品。你的推测过于无礼。

Right, I’ve been meaning to ask… what got ya so freaked out about a kidnapping earlier?
所以之前说的绑架又是什么意思？

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Oh… There’s a pretty scary rumor of indiscriminate kidnappings going around these T Corp. streets.
啊……一直有一些关于发生在T公司街头无差别绑架案的流言。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
These are abandoned streets, so when I saw a dozen or so people running around together, I was scared that you guys might be the infamous kidnapping Syndicate or something...
这里是没什么人走的街道，所以看到成群结队的一大帮人我就以为是传闻中绑架人的帮派之类的……

We need more details. I want the who, when, where, what, how, and why. Proceed.
我们需要更多细节。何人，何时，何地，何事，如何，以及为何。继续。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
P-people have been going missing around here.
一……一直有人在这周围失踪。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
This kinda became the last known location for a bunch of missing people. Everyone becomes a shut-in during the foggy days ‘cause they don’t wanna get kidnapped.
最近传闻说这附近有人无缘无故地失踪了。所以现在大家在浓雾天都会害怕地躲在家里。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
L-look, it’s even on the front page of this T-Times newspaper here. Mysterious Kidnapping Fear Sweeps District.… Not Even A Single Body Found… I can keep reading, if you want...?
你、你看啊，这T公司时报上头版都刊登着呢。惊魂神秘绑架案……尚未发现任何一具受害者尸体……还需要我继续念下去吗？

Meursault, Rodya, and Don Quixote began enthusiastically reading the sensationalized titles and the attached articles on the newspaper he showed us.
默尔索、罗佳和堂吉诃德开始兴致勃勃地读起带着耸人听闻标题的新闻内容。

Oh… Ohoho… I gotta check out that award-winning eatery… it's not so far from where we are...
嚯……嚯喔……这附近还有一家获过奖的餐厅呢……

Aha, so the time retrieval Fixers have said as such in these interviews...
嗯呣……对时间回收收尾人们还有这样的采访……

<Are you guys even reading the same article?>
<大家……真的在读同一篇新闻吗？>

... Lad’s right. There’s a lot less people around here than I remember.
……确实。到处游荡的人比我记忆里的少多了。

This street used to be packed with workers headed to their factory jobs and inventors selling their useless trinkets… It’s never been this... empty.
原来这条街上挤满了去工厂上班的工人和卖些没什么用的东西的发明家……这里从未这么……空旷过。

This empty street of T Corp. was thick with fog, the bustling crowd from Heathcliff's memories nowhere to be seen.
空荡荡的T公司街道上，并没有希斯克利夫所说的熙熙攘攘的人群，取而代之的是遮天蔽日的浓雾。

Maybe the lack of color made the fog appear even thicker.
也许是因为缺乏色彩，使得雾显得更加浓厚了。

This reminds me of the kidnapping ‘rumor’ we heard when we were working on the Blade Lineage case.
这跟几天前我们在处理与剑契组相关的事件时听到的“传言”差不多。

Missing people… Maybe there really is a messed-up kidnapping, human trafficking Syndicate roaming this area.
失踪啊……可能是因为有一个绑架并贩卖人口的恶性帮派在这一带活动吧？

I’ve never heard of such Syndicate strutting about this place. Back when I lived here, at least.
……我以前从没听过有这样的家伙在外面大摇大摆地游荡。至少……我曾在这里生活时没有。

It is a statistical impossibility for a human trafficking Syndicate to leave zero evidence behind. There is bound to be one or two they let slip between their fingers.
如果是以贩卖人口为目的的帮派，那么总会留下一两条蛛丝马迹。

Especially if this 'Syndicate' is so prolific to the point of indirectly discouraging the public from leaving their homes, a body or two will invariably be found.
特别是当运作规模大到能给街道带来如此大的变化时。那么应该至少也会发现一两具尸体才对。

If they really didn’t leave any bodies, then maybe it’s worse than just your usual murders...
如果真的一具尸体都没留下……那么这就不单单只是杀人事件的程度了……

Maybe it’ll be more dangerous the more we look into it?
也就是说我们越深入这起事件，处境就会越危险？

<If it’s not just another violent tragedy… then maybe there’s more to this than we think. Maybe there's some powerful organization pulling the strings...>
<这可不单单是什么残忍的故事……也许背后有着更为强大的势力在推波助澜。>

Y’know, that’s a lot of conjecture to make just from the fact that no bodies have been found.
不。仅凭有没有尸体这一点来判断全貌是很困难的~

I'm sorry?
什么？

Guys. The Night in the Backstreets.
别忘了后巷深宵。

A single sweep from those Sweepers leaves nothing behind. Every trash in the Backstreets, including corpses, is completely cleaned up.
那些清道夫所到之处，所有的垃圾，包括尸体都会被清理得一干二净。

Right… They'd clean up even the corpses, yeah.
确实……他们会连尸体都清理得干干净净。

'Course, it's kinda scary that they clean up more than just trash~
当然，他们不单单是在清理垃圾这点显得有点吓人呢~

<Yeah… The idea of Sweepers really freaked Sinclair out for a while.>
<清道夫……有段时间着实把辛克莱吓得够呛。>

… That’s because Rodya kept making funny noises and Sweeper impressions at me every night…!
……那是因为罗佳小姐每天晚上都会对我装出清道夫的样子然后发出奇怪的声音……！
